title: Canonical natural image filtration and stable pages
statement: Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$ be left exact additive functors between Grothendieck abelian categories with derived categories satisfying injective acyclicity [def-sp-composite-acyclicity]. Let $E$ be an $E_2$ cohomological spectral-sequence functor [def-sp-spectral-sequence], objectwise isomorphic to the Grothendieck truncation spectral sequence. There is a decreasing filtration $HF_X^n$ [def-sp-filtration] on $R^n(GF)(X)$ whose step at every integer p is the canonical abutment transport of imageFiltration(n,n+1-p). Every step is natural in X, and for $p,q\ge0$, $r\ge2$, $r>\max(p,q+1)$, the term $E_r^{p,q}(X)$ is isomorphic to $\operatorname{gr}^p HF_X^{p+q}$.

source.place: Tag 015N; spectral-object stable-page and successive-image quotient calculation

proof.text: Construct HF by transporting imageFiltration(n,n+1-p) using Subobject.exists. Monotonicity and functorial order preservation prove antitonicity.

Express each step as the image of the canonical map H^n(bottom,n+1-p) to the derived composite. Naturality of spectral-object H and of the abutment isomorphism gives a commutative square. imageSubobjectMap gives the required lift on images.

Use spectralSequencePageXIso with outer indices q-r+2 and q+r-1. First-quadrant vanishing replaces these by bottom and top. nonempty_cokernel_ofLE_imageFiltration_iso identifies the resulting term with the quotient of consecutive images. Cokernel transport along the abutment isomorphism identifies it with the graded piece of HF. Compose with the page-r component of the supplied c.
